packaged_food.rule_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 - Rule 6 (prototype mapping)
packaged_food.note: PROTOTYPE RULES ONLY. Verify against current official notifications/amendments before any real enforcement use.

rules.description: Common/generic name of the commodity must be declared.
Maximum Retail Price (inclusive of all taxes) must be declared.
Net quantity must be declared in standard units (g/kg/ml/l/number).
Name and address of manufacturer/packer/importer must be declared.
Consumer care name/address/telephone/email must be declared.
Month and year of manufacture/packing/import must be declared.
